title: Mobile money agent cash-in/cash-out value, national monthly
publication: CBK National Payments System — Mobile Payments statistics
source_table: Mobile Payments (Year, Month, Active Agents, Total Registered Mobile Money Accounts (Millions), Total Agent Cash in Cash Out (Volume Million), Total Agent Cash in Cash Out (Value KSh billions))
definition: CBK's National Payments System statistics publish one live, continuously-updated monthly national table for mobile money: agent cash-in/cash-out (CICO) activity, with active-agent counts, registered-account counts, CICO transaction volume (millions of transactions) and CICO transaction value (Ksh billions). This is the only comparable governed national monthly mobile-money series CBK publishes as one table; it does not publish a single reconciled national total covering every mobile-money rail (person-to-person transfers, paybill/till merchant payments, bank-to-mobile-wallet transfers, bill payments) as one comparable monthly aggregate distinct from CICO.
scope_note: The Atlas promotes CBK's published Total Agent Cash in Cash Out (Value KSh billions) column as the national IND-MOBILE-MONEY-VOLUME series, converted to KES millions. This measures the value of cash deposited into and withdrawn from mobile money wallets through the agent network. It is CBK's own headline mobile-money activity metric, but it is not a full economy-wide total of every mobile-money transaction type (P2P transfers, paybill, till/merchant payments not routed through agent CICO are excluded). The Atlas does not relabel this as 'total mobile money transactions' and does not sum it with unrelated CBK payment-system tables to manufacture a broader total.
access_note: Live statistics table (no static PDF/report), continuously updated by CBK; access_method web_download via CBK-STATISTICS source. Figures below were verified against the published table's last-six-rows view during this P25 session.
